title: Ecosystem navigation
description: The navigation of one ecosystem's section, in Zensical's nav shape. The site places it under the ecosystem's name from ecosystems.toml. Paths are relative to the ecosystem's staging directory.

version.description: The contract version. Version 1 is the only one.

item.description: A page with its title, as { "Title": "page.md" }, or a section, as { "Title": [items] }.

page.description: A Markdown page, relative to the ecosystem's staging directory: no leading slash, and no parent segment.
